summary: Day dominated by legal rulings and Reliance capital markets activity. Delhi High Court halted London arbitration in UN cargo dispute; Reliance plans second $1 billion bond sale in three weeks amid strong FDI inflows.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court halts London arbitration in UN military cargo dispute.
MCD reports 5 officers suspended, 543 properties demolished, 178 sealed post-Satya Niketan PG collapse.
Reliance Industries planning $1 billion local currency bond sale, second offering in three weeks.
India records highest-ever FDI of $94.53 billion in FY2025-26; cumulative inflows since 2014 reach $843 billion.
Liqvd Digital India IPO subscribed 5.08 times on final day; 3.86 crore shares bid against 75.94 lakh offered.
